$comment: Legacy compound decision records exempted from scripts/check-decision-record-shape.mjs (srs#607, owner ruling 2026-09-07, comment 5573379090). Each pre-dates the ruling's enforcement floor (decision_date 2026-09-07 or earlier) and is grandfathered rather than decomposed — decomposing a charter-class record would itself be a rewrite of it. Entries were found by running the check's own heuristic (>=2 numbered/bulleted lines in decision_statement) over the live corpus at ruling time; growing this file for a record dated after the floor is not permitted — that is exactly the case the check exists to catch.
